name: panos_security_profile_group
description: Groups multiple security profiles (Antivirus, Anti-Spyware, Vulnerability, URL Filtering, WildFire, File Blocking, Data Filtering, DNS Security) into a single object that can be referenced by Security Policy rules.

fields.label: Name
fields.helpText: Name of the security profile group. Use alphanumeric characters and hyphens; will be normalized to snake_case for Terraform labels.

fields.label: Description
fields.placeholder: Optional description of this profile group

fields.label: Scope
fields.helpText: Whether this object lives in a VSYS (standalone firewall) or Device Group (Panorama-managed).

fields.label: VSYS
fields.helpText: The virtual system to assign this object to.

fields.label: Device Group
fields.helpText: The Panorama device group to assign this object to.

fields.label: Antivirus Profile
fields.helpText: Reference to an Antivirus security profile. Leave blank to skip antivirus inspection for rules using this group.

fields.label: Anti-Spyware Profile
fields.helpText: Reference to an Anti-Spyware security profile. Leave blank to skip anti-spyware inspection.

fields.label: Vulnerability Profile
fields.helpText: Reference to a Vulnerability protection profile. Leave blank to skip vulnerability inspection.

fields.label: URL Filtering Profile
fields.helpText: Reference to a URL Filtering profile. Leave blank to skip URL filtering.

fields.label: WildFire Analysis Profile
fields.helpText: Reference to a WildFire Analysis profile. Leave blank to skip WildFire analysis.

fields.label: File Blocking Profile
fields.helpText: Reference to a File Blocking profile. Leave blank to skip file blocking.

fields.label: Data Filtering Profile
fields.helpText: Reference to a Data Filtering profile. Leave blank to skip data filtering.

fields.label: DNS Security Profile
fields.helpText: Reference to a DNS Security profile. Leave blank to skip DNS security inspection.
